name: Alhambra Theatre
note: Moorish Revival movie palace (1926): bracketed tile eave, star frieze, two minarets, marquee and blade sign; front found from the ring in the fit frame

name: Swedish American Hall
note: Swedish American Hall, 1907: Scandinavian half-timber front on Market St (front 137, measured), twin steep white gables with scalloped bargeboards, shingled dormers, entrance canopy at the left

name: Victoria Theatre
note: Victoria Theatre, 1908: red Mission-Revival front on 16th St (front 356, measured), stepped scalloped parapet, marquee, blade sign; mural and graffiti on the Capp St side
